notes.title: COMMUNITY ITEMS ARE NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.notes:
Now you can customize your Steam profile with items from Irmão do Jorel. We’re excited to show you the new items available, and if you’ve already played the game, you’ll receive the cards retroactively!

[h2]Steam Trading Cards[/h2]
[i]Jorel's Brother and the most Important Game of the Galaxy[/i] now has [b]Steam Trading Cards[/b], which you can unlock by playing the game over time. These cards are tradable and can be used to unlock special Irmão do Jorel badges, emojis (for use in the Steam chat system), and profile backgrounds.

notes.title: Bugfixes and Minor Improvements - June 03, 2024
notes.notes:
[h2]Hi Guys![/h2]

Thank you very much for all the feedback you sent to improve the game! We've made some improvements, and we're also aware of issues we're working to fix!

[list][h3]Language Selection Flow[/h3]
[*]We have simplified the language selection process, making it easier and more intuitive.

[h3]General Adjustments and Fixes[/h3]
[*]We made minor adjustments and fixes to improve the app's performance and stability.

[h3]Control Indication Improvements[/h3]
[*]Control indications are now clearer and more precise, making navigation easier.

[h3]Age Selection Screen[/h3]
[*]We have now included a new screen to select your age, ensuring a more personalized experience.
[/list]

Please feel free to send us feedback on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1398910/discussions/] Steam forum[/url] by logging into our[url=https://discord.gg/doubledashstu ] Discord [/url]or message us at support@doubledashstudios.com.

notes.title: Release Date of Chapter 2 of the Most Important Game of the Galaxy!
notes.notes:
[b]Uncover the Universe in "Jorel's Brother and the Most Important Game of the Galaxy: Chapter 2"![/b] Launching on August 22nd!

Get ready for the intergalactic adventure of a lifetime! Take on the challenge of facing alien bureaucracy and unraveling the secrets of the universe. The teaser is already available on YouTube, check it out in the video below!

[previewyoutube=p3AEU7iwEbI;full][/previewyoutube]

Take advantage of the [b]20% discount[/b] launch promotion and embark on this epic journey. The action takes place on the Spaceship of Jorel's Recruitment, where you'll confront the tyrant DJ Zorge and his endless raves!

Prepare to become a true Space Warrior, undergoing physical and mental training, practical and psychotechnical exams, and thrilling space battles. The second part of the "Most Important Game of the Galaxy" promises an electrifying and unforgettable experience! Don't miss this opportunity to explore the universe and ensure order in the cosmos.

We'll see you in the second part of the Most Important Game of the Galaxy!

notes.notes:
[h1]THE MOST IMPORTANT LAUNCH IN THE GALAXY?![/h1]

Today we are very happy to announce that the game is finally available for purchase.

But can't you play everything at once? 🤔
 
Calm down, we'll explain: We've separated the game into three chapters, which will be released at intervals of two months until October! Until then, we want to bring the game to more platforms! So enjoy and don't forget to leave a review on the Steam page! 🥰❤️
